svg.title: OpenDART MCP · server design
svg.desc: An MCP client reaches the server over Streamable HTTP at /mcp, behind Host and Origin allowlists. FastMCP middleware logs, rate-limits, compacts schemas, counts usage, and recovers errors before tools, resources, and prompts run. Services resolve companies and periods and read OpenDART through one gateway that caches, coalesces, limits concurrency, and retries once. Server state holds settings, background tasks, usage counters, the company directory, and the document store, whose downloads use the SDK's download client. A generated service registry and a component lock are checked in and verified by scripts.
svg.text: RUNTIME · one request from an MCP client to OpenDART
CHECKED-IN FILES · generated and verified by scripts
Access log → rate limit → compact schemas → usage metrics → error recovery
Resolve the company and period, fan out reads, normalize into output models
Pure layers: domain/ · events/ · registry/ · documents/
TTL cache bounded by records (LRU) · identical in-flight calls coalesced
At most 5 concurrent · 1 retry on transient failures, none on quota or maintenance
Instructive errors · requests counted per KST day
JSON client for gateway calls · download client for the company directory and filing documents
HTTPS /engapi · 82 JSON services · 3 ZIP downloads · daily request quota
Services read field labels and value kinds from the registry. The lock check fails when a definition changes under its recorded version.
Blue: request / response path · Gray: server state and downloads · Dashed teal: generated and checked files
